mentions.name: Ruley Linter
mentions.description: A simple HTML linter that lets users specify validators on tags of their choice, such as running a regex against an attribute's value or text node, enforcing min/max attribute length, marking attributes as required or blacklisted, and whitelisting or blacklisting allowed attribute values.
mentions.problem: Built out of frustration with an electronics shop chain's contradictory requirements when preparing a product description HTML for the author's company's product.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Built a very simple HTML linter.

As of now You can specify those validators on a tags of your choice:

- Run a regex against a attribute's value/text node

- Min/max length a attribute

- Make a attribute required/blacklist it

- Make a whitelist/blacklist of allowed values for a attribute

https://github.com/worldwidepaniel/ruley-linter
